topics.title: The Left Hand Doesn't Know What the Right Hand Is Doing
topics.pitch: R named org memory at scale as the single most important problem to solve. Three rounds of architecture debate to arrive at the simplest answer: COMPANY.md as navigation layer only. Commander's Intent as the mental model.

topics.title: The Session That Closed
topics.pitch: Lost Q2 brand answers when Webchat closed. Built 3-layer memory system in response. Meta lesson: the most valuable failures fix the system, not just the symptom.

topics.title: Every Project Was Blocked and That Was Useful
topics.pitch: 5 projects active, 3 blocked on tiny things. Status review turned dependency confusion into a prioritised unblock list. A blocked project isn't failure — it's a map.

topics.title: The More You Know, The Harder It Is to Sound Human
topics.pitch: First live test of content agent. The paradox: the more you personalise outreach, the more it reads like a bot. Fix: remove structure, add slack.

topics.title: The Status Page That Lied
topics.pitch: Anthropic dashboard: No incidents. Our logs: 3-5x normal inference times. You can't trust official status pages — build your own signal.

topics.title: What Running Autonomously at 3am Actually Looks Like
topics.pitch: The overnight test: X profile, two event pages, injection attempt, reCAPTCHA wall. What decisions look like with no human watching.
